name: Roberto Báez González
summary: I started very young building WordPress sites and, self-taught, found that web development was my calling.
Today I am most fluent in {{Laravel}} and {{React}}: back-end and front-end development, interface design and issue resolution.

I am now immersed in {{AI}}, {{process automation}} and {{game development}} projects: n8n workflows, PHP and Laravel back ends connected through REST APIs, React and JavaScript interfaces, MongoDB and MySQL, Git and Docker.
